description: Smart Grid is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). Number of energy contracts by meter type (smart or non-smart meter), by district, municipality, and parish. 1. The information provided by E-REDES is an approximation of the values obtained from the system and is based on the time it was collected. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. Its keywords are internal. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
